notes.title: Hotfix #5: Growth
notes.notes:
-Game has been scaled up to 1366x768 
-All moves have been rebalanced to no longer be OFFENSE - DEFENCE. Now moves scale much much better.

Dev Note: In a recent playthrough, I noticed that moves hit their caps much too easily. Wave Slash is one of the biggest offenders offering free wins in Stage 1, With the new rebalance moves will scale much more appropriately. This also applies to the enemy using moves, as they no longer feel like killing you in 1 or 2 hits. Also, chars like Crow feel better to use as it'll actually make it back to their turn in non-Boss fights! I have seen the complaints about Normal feeling like the enemies die too fast and I've tried to address it with the old formula but it just never worked out. I have played with the new scaling and I think it is much better personally but I am eager to hear what you think.

-New Menu command UI
-New "battle log"
-New Zazz face and theme
-New Sync Animation
-New battlebacks for Stages 1, 4, and 7
-Clyde, Robun, and Artica all got new passives
-A!Vira and A!Kaus Australis fights added
-New gun moves O.S.O.K. and Vulcan have been added for gun bosses
-Shields got reworked: Now to match Leaf Shield; Fire, Lightning, Earth and Bubble shield all have "weaknesses" that remove them
*Water removes Fire Shield. Thunder ignores Water Shield. Wood cancels out Thunder Shield. Magical Slash Moves remove Earth Shield. Physical Slash Moves remove Blade Barrier.
-New sprites for Chapter 1 Zazz cutscenes
-Exca fight on Hard now starts with an additional "Point"
-Exca's Glitch move now Silences and Blinds specifically Crow,  Lunez, and Kiyota. This is really mean of him.
-the Mouse hanging on selected enemies is fixed
-Detritus 7 has voice lines (voiced by Bass)
-One New Game+ Akari short scene added in Chapter 1

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.notes:
Hello again! I am pretty happy with the state of Truth and Madness, and here are a list of fixes I've been working on. I also want to thank the community tab, content creators, and the Dyztopia discord for pointing out bugs and typos and contributing to the game's health. Some of these fixes have been live before this announcement but I wanted to document the changes.


 Fix Stage 4 and Stage 6 having event locks.
 Fixed the Mini-Vendors sometimes disabling all dialogue. 
 Kunai Strike change: Its Flash condition now activates at 0 MP. To prevent infinites, it has a +2 Cooldown when Exhausted.
 Credits cleaned up.
 Summons and Clones no longer benefit from level up bonuses
 New level formulas: HP on enemies got raised by about 7 per level, and flat stat bonuses properly implemented (This is like 1 point of stat per 10 levels.)
 Super Bosses now have about +15 extra stats per difficulty.
 Agility now gets level bonuses. Before it was just a flat stat, but now it increases by a % of their level.
 Late game mobs that had two actions now only have two actions if they are the last one standing (This is to prevent a group of four mobs from going sicko mode)
 Akira, Runi, Fredek all had their HP buffed
 Fredek INT buffed
 Poison Wave now down to 3MP.
 In Kael's ending, he now uses the updated dialogue (and dialogue skips) 
 Final Zazz, Arch-Demon Capricorn, and the Stage 9 demons all got buffed. All hail Arch-Traffic
 Retrogrades mostly nerfed. Retrogrades that introduce a mechanic (Like Libra and Scorpio) have greatly reduced HP compared to those that don't
 Madness Mode Boss Transitions now look and sound smoother
 Reworked some Battle Lab encounters
 Stage 4 Boss in Madness made significantly harder.

notes.title: Hotfix #3: Squashing Bugs
notes.notes:
What is Changing?

In order to fix a rare and brutal bug, Some moves had to be completely rewritten.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/79cb51b6c1c0ce4d9cca736b723d859757b72aa8.png
Pictured here is a sad Edgar who not only can't attack but cannot select any physical moves. This happens randomly and seemingly for no reason other than the enemy AI picks a skill that has a selection condition and for some reason that calls a weapon range block that Dyztopia doesn't even use. It's weird, and it was a lot of effort to rewrite all of this but the bug no longer happens. Here's a list of skill and scenarios directly affected by the change.


 Snackrifice now can target anyone including the user. (I do not like this change but I had to concede it to fix the bug)
 
 Bloodseeker now can target anyone instead of just Bleeding foes.
 
 Chase vs. the real Morgalia had to be rewritten. Now only the story mission can get the alternate game over.
 
 A lot of enemy-related selection conditions had to be rewritten into their AI. For example, all of the Angel equipment that makes you immune to Exile now uses the AI instead of a selection condition.
 
 Oblivion (D) can now target bosses. It doesn’t Exile them, but it will strip them of their buffs and shields. 


New Content

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/dd0dd8ec1c812a94323cad853511312bfa9d1d56.gif

There is a crumb of new content. Runi equipped with Twin Doom will now sport a cool palette swap to match the fun memories made on that route.  Also, for people who have Twin Doom and for people who are currently running through the Worst Timeline. Here's a special win pose for you. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/b6edded5bcb3dd001498af33ee0fecd2d45b8f09.gif

In the spirit of all things Gemini, there is also a new Anomaly. This time it's Pollux. And Vira got a new sprite as well (just like I said last patch notes!)

That's it for new content. The content is very light this time because I am focusing on the sequel. (or trying to, anyway.)

Other Changes
-Certain tracks have been replaced in Chapter 2.
-The Electro Ball hazard in Stage 6 has an actual animation. It should be more clear that it’s a threat. Now appears in more stages too.
-Runi’s Mind Spring Circlet is now retired. Replaced by Storm Circlet (+24 INT per action she takes. Please Storm responsibly!)
-Bully reworked. Now adds LUCK to damage instead of a flat +30% (I think this change is a buff but also it helps players itemize Genesis.)
-Wash Away is gone. Replaced with Waterfall
-New Move: Psycho Cutter
-New Move: Aura Shards
-New Move: Anti-Matter Shot
-Reworked Lunez's Death Row. Now includes Meteor Saber and Poison Cleave base and disables all Flash too
-New Move: Poison Cleave
-Eliza gets a 3rd level skill
-[spoiler]Virgo [/spoiler]gets a 1st level skill!
-Fixed Gotcha "dropping" Paola's Mask
-Fixed Ink Swathe shard and Nova shard being bundled together. Gatcha isn't that generous.
-Kiyota no longer has a social link smiley at Pon Pon during the Lunez Route
-Kiyota now has catch-up EXP in the Lunez Route. Turns out Visual Novels give experience.
-Fixed weirdness in 4-2 where the backtrack ladder would be impassable
-6-3 got a major rehaul. No longer can you go to the bottom if you miss the jump, and a lot of incorrect eventing was changed to make sure things ran smoothly.
-7-1 through 7-4 all have new geography
-Stage 8 has new areas
-Stage 7 fireballs now have better hit detection.
-Zazz and Twelve dialogue slightly altered
-Fixed magnets not resetting properly
-I went through all of the skills and gave them all the correct cooldowns. (Some were hilariously off. Whoops!)
-Hyperkinetic Plate no longer makes your Agility Invalid. (This will only affect new Hyperkenetic Plates. The item works fine in battle but there is weirdness in the equip screen)
-Incorrect Icons have been fixed (These will only affect new armor and weapons.)
-The skill manual was missing Exhaust. That has been fixed
-Pollux now has her skill list streamlined and shouldn't cause lag 

That's all for now! I hope to update y'all soon on the sequel!

notes.title: Hot Fix Finale #2 + A Foolish Update
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone! I've come back to do some fixing to Dyztopia as well as add a timely April Fools item. There's also a change to the Equip Screen! Now Shards and Other Armor will have descriptions! So you can see what skill the Shard provides without having to go in and out of menus so much. Unfortunately, this change isn't retroactive and will only apply to new shards you obtain AFTER the update. (This is a major reason why weapon upgrades won't be returning in the sequel.) 

Updates
-Added a new Equip screen to help show more information. Especially for Shards
-New Seasonal Item: The Foolish Cap! Prevents you from getting EXP!
-Angels have left the Hard Battle Lab. New battles now replace them.

Originally, Angels were added to spice up the battle lab, but since adding their rematches in the Secret Area, I don't think they really belong in the Battle Lab anymore.

-Post-game updates to Antares and Hamal. They each have new mechanics.

In a recent playthrough these two were the most boring of the Faceless fights. I wanted to make them more exciting. Antares would spam low-tier skills which was a little emersion-breaking for a secret post-game boss (IMHO). The new fights are very formidable... and with some new graphics to boot. Vira is another Faceless I have my eyes on, but I want to resume work on the sequel so she's the same for now.

-Many enemies have been given new Royal moves. 
-Ink Swathe has its animation made more clear

Fixes
- 4-5 magnets now work correctly. No more soft lock.
- 5-3 has new graphics for the lower section. No longer uses the old Dicetopia border.
- Various typos were fixed in skill descriptions and dialogue.
- Various shards were given incorrect icons
- Fixed some of Fredek's weapons using the wrong icon for AGILITY
- Fixed Embargo Aura. 

Embargo RAI would prevent you from using certain items. There was a bug that would not only auto-remove it for the user but EVERY OTHER BUFF AS WELL. This includes when the player uses Embargo too. It now works as intended. Please Clap.

- Fixed Chaos Breaker incorrectly being a Magical skill even though it's a Physical one.
- Added Adapt description for Toxice. (It had the Adapt properties but wasn't labeled)
- ESP Blackhole (D) incorrectly stated that it used Attack and Resistance
- Fixed Aquarius Soul not giving the user Resistance to every element. 

That's it for now! Back to work on Dyztopia 2!

notes.title: Winter Update
notes.notes:
Dyztopia General Fixes


WINTER UPDATE
The Winter Update is here with plenty of goodies! Costumes for Crow, Rosie, Lunez, Chase and Genesis are now available. In addition, All costumes are permanently available! 

Fate Stones and Zodiac Souls

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/89e40e80943619b5562ed2a354e90ae4b61b6fff.png

There's a new resource available called Fate Stones. You get them for defeating Zodiacs. You get one for each true condition.

- Defeat Normally (Free Space)
- Defeat without using Items
- Defeat within a certain time limit (unique to each boss)

Using these Fate Stones you can craft powerful Shards called Zodiac Souls. Using these will give you an edge in battle. You get the recipe after defeating each Zodiac except for three of them (Gemini, Aquarius, and [REDACTED]) for which you have to find some other way to craft them other than Poakun.

Obtaining all of these conditions in Hard Mode will also award an Achievement! These are the Zodiac GOLD achievements. You can obtain them naturally during the story or in the Secret Area. After defeating a Faceless, you can do a true rematch with the Zodiac, and there you can fight to earn the achievement or farm Fate Stones for Zodiac Souls.

The Secret Area also received a bit of a revamp. It looks cleaner now, and there’s even a new area to explore if you can find it, that is. I’m sure you’ll be rewarded if you do.
 
New Content
-15 New Achievements!
-New Fate Stones to craft powerful items
-New Secret Boss! [spoiler]Ophiucus[/spoiler]
-New Costumes!
-Unsynced Aquarius has a new mechanic!
-Rematches for The Zodiacs and certain Angels

Balance Changes
-Costumes now scale in price with your story progress (With the sole exception of Runi's.)
-Bulwark now adds barrier equal to Detritus’s DEFENCE stat to allies every turn instead of level. 
-Damage from statuses (Such as Aqua Bolas, Vine/Shadow Trap) can no longer kill bosses. They can still kill enemies.
-All “Push” Skills have a cap. They can’t be pushed more than four times. This is to save an interaction between Reaper and Multi-push skills. This interaction is still very strong.
-Multi-Kicker has a push cap of 10. There was an infinite with Heart Aura, so I had to make it not interact with lifesteal. Now with the cap, it has full interaction with that skill.
-Rapid Shot Damage Increase
-Aqua Bolas barrier damage doubled
-Hyper Heal has its cooldown increased to 7
-Vanguard and Ripotse no longer have a damage cap of 500
-Riposte MP Up
-Bonus Mod now gives +30 stats (up from +10)
-Boozy Mod now gives +50 to all stats (up from +10)
-Blood Berry is now a Magical move instead of a Physical one
-Vine Trap now triggers on Physical Hits AND Any Wood-Type spell
-Stop Gap has no Cooldown.
-Coat of Farms removes Vulnerable, Silence, and  now CORRECTLY removes debuffs


Bug Fixes
-Typos and repeated dialogue fixed in certain areas
-Sync Skills will now remember that you can only Sync once, even if a Synced party member died.  This includes Chase’s Ultimate Item.
-Saying yes to Capricorn now adds +1 to Akari's ending instead of setting it to 1. 
-Candy Slinger was incorrectly labeled as a Runi Weapon. It's now a Crow Weapon.
-Brainstorm and Snackrifice always have Flash

Dev Commentary
I initially wanted the Winter Update to be pretty small, as I wanted to focus more on Dyztopia 2 development, but knowing how I dev that just wasn't going to happen. I didn't think I'd make it to five Costumes for this update but here we are (Plus Chase uses a completely new sprite sheet).  I'm happy with the new batch. I put a lot of thought into them,  The skills this time around I feel don't seem unique at first but I really like the design of Flamlanx, Timber, and Toxice.

I brought back Genesis's Bio Bomb and I like that Rosie has an Alcohol Healing skill that's way better than Runi's showing that she is truly the better bartender.  

As for the GOLD achievements. Getting them in the story is tough. I was able to get all of them with cruddy gear, but some of them were nightmares (Looking at you Libra). That being said, getting them in the post-game is way easier when you have more party members, and the only thing you miss out on are Shards by not doing them.

SPOILER TIME
[spoiler] Now, I'm not saying anything about the fate of Dyztopia 2, but in the event it doesn't happen, I wanted to do a true Ophiucus fight. The fight is TOUGH and it looks fantastic. I think it's my favorite fight of Dyztopia next to Y-Phen. I'm being a little cryptic about it because it's kind of hard to get to, but it is obtainable in any non-Evil Runi run.  [/spoiler]

And that's it for the Winter Update! I think it is really tailored towards post-game, and there's a healthy amount of secrets here that I haven't shared.  As for me, I'm probably going to take the month of December off from Dev and enjoy the holidays, That being said... I'm going to update my achievement guide (with exact turns on the Gold achievements) and still be available for bug fixes and typos so don't hesitate to contact me on Discord or Twitter. 

Happy Holidays, y'all.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/Dyztopia1
Discord: https://discord.gg/Qqa35n2XvE

notes.title: Dyztopia: Turbo Update
notes.notes:
I'm here to announce an update to Dyztopia called Turbo! With the new update, players can now dash across the fields of Pon Pon or the bustling city of Vulcanite just by pressing shift. The speed is much, much faster than the average Dyztopia speed. It's hard to go back to older versions after this.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/f2dcea57fd177d976fc4b9fdaa3f49f18f5925b1.gif

But that's not all. By holding down shift while descending a ladder, you can also Ladder Drop and speed down to the bottom. This, combined with Dashing, means that Akira will fly through stages like never before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/de779879478ae9791606e27b1a1208ce740cdd0b.gif

BUT THAT'S NOT ALL! Included in Turbo, you can now skip cutscenes. By holding down the Cancel button when it prompts you to do so, you can skip almost all cutscenes in the game. This includes significant story events and Syncs as well. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/a8ddf3bfd321deb474be87c31dbe651f7d169f33.gif

Included are also many Quality of Life features, such as a backlog and rebalanced gameplay. So when can you play Dyztopia Turbo? Well, Deviations came out a few months after the initial release, so by that approximation, it will be available RIGHT NOW! 

Load up your old Deviations file or start a new file. The game is ready to go Turbo. 

Here's a list of other changes in the update. 
-Refresh Passive now requires more Awakening Stones and Level 25
-Surge only triggers at Maximum MP instead of Above 4
-Healing Skills have a rolling Cooldown. The more you heal, the longer all healing cooldown will be. These reset every battle, and healing skills will go off cooldown at the start of every battle.
-Panic Ploy now works properly
-Panic Ploy level 2 changed from Flips Hard Buffs to +1 Turn
-Lunch Break now heals significantly more
-Taco 4-pack heals less
-Wave Slash and Paraselene have reduced damage at lower and higher damage at higher levels. Wave Slash can now go above 1000 damage. 
-Fixed Morgalia's House cutscene not working properly
-Fixed the bad ending not being able to end.
-The Ski section is now just open. No need for a key
-Exhaust now three turns. Nothing makes you immune to Exhaust anymore. (Can still be cured.)
-Exhaust now takes you out of Sync.
-Bolt Punch is now 1 MP. Gains Flash when you have 3+ actions.
-After taking too many actions, your damage is greatly reduced. (Runi Nerf)
-Quick Fix gives Exhaust at the end of the turn instead of right after. 
-A new animation plays when an Enemy resists an element
-You lose Hype when hitting an Enemy resistance, and the enemy does too.
-Multi-Elemental moves now use the average of the elements instead of the higher of the two. Previously, Multi-Elemental moves bypassed the elemental system, which made them like Type less moves but better. Now they're more in line with other moves.
-Aqua Bolas damage increase
-Aqua Spinner no longer makes Aqua Bolas AoE. Now adds damage. 


Please enjoy the game! If you have any questions, feel free to contact me!

Gmail: officialdyztopiagame@gmail.com
Twitter

notes.title: Patch 1: Happy Two Years!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/a0075758d76899c1d02c532bb0b99613c008c1c1.png
Dyztopia started development two years ago back when I was learning Aseprite and RPG Maker together. I want to thank everyone for helping me get to year 2. It's been an honor. 


Content Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/ef66512f2724986fcff3b5566c5f9fb8466c0f66.png
JUMP FIX
One of the oldest bugs in the game, you could use a jump block a tile over if you walked over it. It was so old that I resigned to just making the maps work around it, but it has been fixed in this update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/df53c34a7bd0629cefdd50ed683d2cbb2707fd2f.png
Weapon Trading
A new merchant appeared who doesn't dabble in DEBIT but rather rare items from red demons. The weapons themselves require some work to make them worth it. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/5660a675868ef9a44313f06e5b70ff5bbdc38289.png
Achievements and Steam Overlay!
Steam overlay and Achievements were not present in the launch, however, I rolled out the change about a week after and am now making an official announcement. You can take screenshots and unlock achievements! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/f3f369b74c4cd915d9dd063b4ede1b4ded26a0ee.png
Red Ducks
Exclusive to Hard Mode. Red Ducks replace certain Blue Ducks. Red Ducks do not heal, and you may only save using them once. Originally there were no saves, but I felt that that didn't make the game harder just wasted more time. 


Patch Notes: 
-Kunai Strike now inflicts -40 Barrier Damage
-Items now have animations
-Zazz Fight 1 has his mechanic reworked and a new spell...
-Items in the first Asterisk Shop reduced costs significantly
-New item: Ring of Sustenance, gain stats while exhausted. Purchasable at the first shop.
-Rally skills removed. They still exist in the code to not break save functionality, but they've been replaced or removed.
-Fixed a crash that would happen if you had too many saves
-Fixed a crash that would lock the screen but continue to play sounds (i.e. stop rendering the game)
-Added optional saves to each world map sequence. 
-Fixed various typos
-Bubble Beam description fixed

notes.title: Buncha Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! First off I'd like to thank you for playing Dyztopia! Second I'm here to address a few major bugs in the game.

Block Pushing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/84570458b7bc58f10d306ad7a79d89ff1b83085e.png

It is possible to walk through walls if you hug the block and press forward. The timing is awkward (at least for me) but other users have been able to do it more consistently. To fix this, I move the block backward so that no pushing should occur. 


Infinite Sand Tomb
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/be1b6516a6a0a0b53a4f8a26c60df9117c4d0368.png

It is possible because of how Scorpio ends, to get inflicted with Sand Tomb forever. When this happens, the party member inflicted with it basically soft locks the game when they're in battle. This likely happens because of the awkwardness of RPG Maker Force Actions and handling an Enemy running away. 

There's also a second part to this glitch that lets you have Infinite Libra or Gemini Sync, so now the battle removes those states BEFORE Scorpio attempts to run away. 

Dyzparity
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/0e90de38a29edd04d2c010fca803560dd052f381.png 
Disparity would lock the game if you used it on a unit that had more Hype than you. That's wack so it's been fixed 


Balance Changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/c560ec3f495d54046406ca265f4fe9f16b9103c8.png
-Dyne spells no longer give Exhaust, they now deal statuses at 2x Luck vs an Enemies 1x Luck. The reason for this is that Dyne spells were made at an early point in development and they kinda failed to carve a niche between all the powerful spells in Dyztopia. Getting one of these spells should feel good, so their new niche is hitting hard even if you have low INT, and being more consistent in applying status effects. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43374882/80db0f7b5842b1d16bb9b740517cdd28130da913.png


-There have been more Keys added to Stage 4. This will both make it harder to get soft-locked by using too many keys and help AGI Keyring be more powerful. Also! New graphics for Keys and Doors!


And that's it for the updates! I'm going to continue working on this and feel free to give me feedback! 

The best way to reach me is in the Dyztopia discord: https://discord.gg/m2WfxN8w

Cheers!
